note: Set A captures nearly all symbol definitions and relationships on the page (T_Aero, T_Gen, N_Gear, I_Drivetrain, I_Rotor, P0, Delta_Omega, Delta_Omega_dot, theta, Delta_theta) with accurate quotes and the Region 3 condition kept on the generator-torque and aerodynamic-torque claims. Set B's five claims are all supported but omit most of the page's key definitions, including rated mechanical power P0 and the drivetrain/rotor/generator inertias. A's only weakness is a duplicated generator-torque/inverse-proportionality claim, which is redundant rather than wrong. Both sets are free of invented or misbound values.
